findings.title: fetch in client.ts has no timeout/abort signal
findings.note: fetch has no AbortSignal/timeout, so a non-responding remote hangs the await indefinitely. The sibling client-admin.ts (line 11) has AbortSignal.timeout(5000), and recent history shows a timeout fix intended for both clients was only applied to one, leaving this path unfinished.

findings.title: Empty catch block silently swallows fetch errors in client.ts
findings.note: Errors (including the timeout/network failures noted above) are caught and discarded with no logging, unlike client-admin.ts which logs via console.error. Callers cannot distinguish a failed request from a legitimate null JSON body.

findings.title: Skipped test for unimplemented bulk pricing feature
findings.note: priceOf in src/cart/pricing.ts only does a flat lookup (returns 1000 for A1, not 900); the skipped test documents a bulk-pricing discount path that was never implemented, with no ticket or date attached to the skip.

findings.title: newCheckout feature flag permanently off, flow never finished

evidence.quote:
// newCheckout has been off since launch; the new flow was never finished
  newCheckout: false,

findings.note: checkout.ts still branches on isEnabled("newCheckout") (src/checkout/checkout.ts:7-8) to call total(cart), but the comment admits the new flow was never completed; the dead/unfinished branch and its dependency remain in the live code path indefinitely with no ticket referenced.

findings.title: Deprecated legacyFormat still exercised on live checkout path
findings.note: Marked deprecated ~704 days ago with no ticket reference, yet checkout.ts still calls legacyFormat on the default (flag-off) path, so the deprecated code is not a dead leftover but the actual production behavior.
